🔐 **F-2386-1 — A PLAINTEXT COPY OF A LIVE CREDENTIAL SITS ONE DIRECTORY ABOVE THE REPO, AT MODE 644, AND EVERY INSTRUMENT THIS FACTORY OWNS IS BLIND TO IT BY CONSTRUCTION (measured s2386).** `/Users/robin/Claude/Projects/Gold` — note the path, it is not a directory — is a **93 B** file, mode **644**, mtime **2026-07-31T21:50 local**, holding one line: `OPENROUTER_API_KEY=<73 chars>`. 🔑 **THE MECHANISM IS CERTAIN, BECAUSE THE IDENTICAL BUG BIT THE FIRE THAT FOUND IT, IN THE SAME SESSION: the repo path contains a SPACE.** An unquoted `> /Users/robin/Claude/Projects/Gold Rush/.env.local` writes to `.../Gold` and passes `Rush/.env.local` as a second word; s2386 typed an unquoted `sed -n 1p /Users/robin/Claude/Projects/Gold Rush/scripts/law-surfaces.mjs`, sed took `.../Gold` as its first file operand, and **printed the key into the fire transcript.** ⚖️ **SEVERITY STATED HONESTLY AND DELIBERATELY NOT INFLATED — THREE THINGS THIS IS NOT.** (1) **NOT a sixth credential**: the value is **byte-identical** to `.env.local`'s `OPENROUTER_API_KEY` (sha256 prefix `3d6eacd97ccdce34`, compared by hash, no value printed), so it is a DUPLICATE of one of F-2299-1's five and that item's rotation neutralises it. (2) **NOT a repo exposure**: the path is outside the Gold Rush repo AND `/Users/robin/Claude/Projects` is **not a git repo at all**, so it can never be committed; the value appears in **0 of 24,518 tracked files** (full-content scan, not a name grep). (3) **NOT newly disclosed by the transcript leak**: `logs/fire-*.log` is untracked and ignored (authoritative `git ls-files --others --exclude-standard` test, F-2358-1 — **0** tracked fire logs exist), and F-2299-1 §4 already rules this key must be treated as disclosed because it sat on a public-IP box. **Realised cost is almost certainly ZERO on a single-user Mac.** 🎯 **WHAT EARNS IT A LINE IS THREE THINGS THE DESK CANNOT SEE TODAY.** (a) **The copy is strictly MORE readable than the original the factory protects** — 644 against `.env.local`'s 600, i.e. world-readable where the guarded one is not. (b) **It SHARPENS F-2299-1's cleanup scope**: that item names `.env.local` and the droplet, so "rotate the five and clean up" leaves this file behind — and a stale post-rotation file that LOOKS like config is how a dead key gets pasted back into a live one. (c) **It is invisible to every instrument the factory has, and not by neglect**: `git ls-files --others` cannot see outside the repo, `art-staging-audit` scans declared sinks, F-2357-1's evidence read is scoped to `artifacts/ reviews/`, and `ledger-mirror-exposure` reads mirrors. Every one is correct within its own root. 💡 **THE REUSABLE HALF, AND IT IS A NEW AXIS FOR THIS STREAK'S OWN QUESTION.** Twenty-plus fires have asked *how can this subject set come back EMPTY?* — a throw, a `catch`, a guard, a stale tree, a cwd, a filename, an orthogonal selector. **This one is none of them: the corpus is complete and correct, and the ARTIFACT IS OUTSIDE ITS ROOT.** Every instrument here is repo-rooted, so a sibling path is outside all of them *simultaneously and by construction* — and the more instruments you add, the more confidently the board reports clean. **When every tool is anchored to one root, ask once what lives just outside it.** 🚫 **NO GUARD IS PROPOSED AND THE RESTRAINT IS MEASURED RATHER THAN LAZY: a scanner that reached outside the repo root would have no bounded corpus — it would be sweeping the owner's home directory for secrets, which is worse than the defect and cannot be gated lawfully. A file outside the repo is also not something a repo gate has any standing to police.** ⓘ Verified consumed by nothing: **0** tracked files reference that path as a terminal path (precise test, excluding the escaped `Gold\ Rush` and `%20` forms that fill the STATUS archives — and whose ubiquity is itself evidence the space hazard is known and routinely escaped). ➡️ **OWNER ACTION, and it is why this is a desk item rather than a fire's fix: both halves are owner-only. Deleting needs approval (`rm` is gated by law, and this is the owner's file outside the repo) and rotation is an external service (§7.3).** rec — **(a)** `rm '/Users/robin/Claude/Projects/Gold'`: it is a typo artifact, read by nothing, and its sibling `.env.local` is the real config; **(b)** fold the key into the F-2299-1 rotation you are already owed, which covers it. **Nothing is blocked either way and no fire is waiting on this.**
